references.label: A-E-R-O-S-M-I-T-H targets
references.description: During Multiball, complete the yellow A-E-R-O-S-M-I-T-H targets to light Mystery at the left scoop, then shoot the scoop to add a ball.

references.label: AEROSMITH targets
references.description: Hit the right-wall AEROSMITH targets. Their rebounds can advance the song and enter the Toy Box; stop using this route if they feed the right outlane.

references.label: center ramp
references.description: Alternate the left and center ramps. Shoot both orbits to relight the ramps, then repeat the ramp loop.

references.label: Elevator scoop
references.description: Shoot both orbits to light an Elevator lock, then shoot the Elevator scoop to collect it. Repeat until the third lock starts Elevator Multiball.

references.label: Crank It Up scoop
references.description: Multiball Add-a-Ball: Complete A-E-R-O-S-M-I-T-H to light Mystery, then shoot the left scoop. The first Mystery collected during a multiball adds a ball.

references.label: Lock saucer
references.description: Shoot all eight major Jackpot shots twice. After the second Super Jackpot, shoot the roving double-Jackpot shot, then shoot the lock saucer for the double Super Jackpot and restart the ladder.

references.label: right outlane
references.description: Hit the right-wall AEROSMITH targets. Their rebounds can advance the song and enter the Toy Box; stop using this route if they feed the right outlane.

references.label: Toy Box
references.description: Six-lock Toy Box is the high-ceiling plan, while a three-lock start trades value for safety. A completed song can carry Super Scoring into Multiball; two relocks then raise playfield scoring to 3x. Walk This Way and Same Old Song & Dance remain separate song routes when their shots are reliable.

references.label: Toy Box-flanking targets
references.description: Test the target wall before you depend on the ricochet route. Complete the Toy Box-flanking targets to arm the right-outlane VIP Pass.

references.label: upper loop
references.description: On Premium and LE, backhand the five upper targets. Then complete the upper loop exit to start 2x playfield.
